utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Will the registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-95-17/1-A, the Prosecutor versus Anto Furundzija.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Can we have the appearances.

utterances.speaker: MR. YAPA
utterances.text: May it please Your Honour. Upawansa Yapa. I appear for the Prosecution in this Status Conference. Mr. George Huber is the case manager.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. I should say that the Chamber has received a request from Defence counsel, Mr. Misetic, to participate in this hearing by way of telephonic link.

utterances.speaker: MR. MISETIC
utterances.text: That is correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I'd first like to ask Mr. Misetic if he can hear the proceedings.

utterances.speaker: MR. MISETIC
utterances.text: Yes, I can, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And I ask the appellant whether he is in agreement with this procedure. Are you in agreement with this procedure?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT FURUNDZIJA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And may I ask the Office of the Prosecutor whether it has any objection to the procedure.

utterances.speaker: MR. YAPA
utterances.text: I do not have any objections.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. The Chamber therefore grants the request. This is a Status Conference convened pursuant to Rule 65 bis for the purpose of affording the appellant an opportunity to raise questions with regard to the status of his appeal and the conditions of his detention, and also to provide him with information concerning the status of the case. May I ask the appellant whether he has any particular matters to raise.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT FURUNDZIJA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I personally don't have anything to raise, any issue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. By way of information, I'd like to say that the Chamber intends to deliver judgement in this matter very soon. Are there any other matters that anyone wishes to raise? Mr. Misetic, are you still there with us?

utterances.speaker: MR. MISETIC
utterances.text: Yes, I'm there, and no, I have no issues to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: From the Office of the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: MR. YAPA
utterances.text: We have no matters to be raised.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: The hearing stands adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: at 4.32 p.m.
